title: Fix login flow: show Internet Identity login panel first, then connect backend after authentication

requirements.text: Fix the app initialization flow so that the Internet Identity login screen (SignInScreen) is displayed immediately on app load, before any backend actor initialization or connection attempt. The backend actor must only be initialized after the user has successfully authenticated via Internet Identity.

quotes: App stuck on black screen with 'Connecting to backend...' spinner — never reaches login panel
restore this working state with the login pannel

acceptanceCriteria: On app load, the Internet Identity login screen is shown immediately with no black screen or spinner
The 'Connecting to backend...' spinner is never shown to unauthenticated users
After successful Internet Identity login, the backend actor initializes and the main app loads
All 7 modules (Dashboard, Inventory, Challans, Payments, Petty Cash, Client Balances, Reports) are accessible after login
The Build Info panel (ⓘ icon) shows Backend Actor: Ready and Authentication: Authenticated after login

requirements.text: Ensure the BackendConnectionGate component only wraps authenticated users. Unauthenticated users must be routed directly to the SignInScreen and must never see the BackendConnectionGate loading state.

quotes: Internet Identity login first — no more black screen / stuck loading
Backend/actor connects only after successful login

acceptanceCriteria: BackendConnectionGate is rendered only when the user is authenticated
Unauthenticated users see the SignInScreen directly without any loading spinner
The authentication check in App.tsx gates BackendConnectionGate behind identity availability

requirements.text: Preserve the existing Build Info panel (BuildInfo component, ⓘ icon) that displays: Build Time, Commit Hash, Backend Actor status, Authentication status, Runtime Errors, and Quick Actions (health check, diagnostics copy). This panel must remain accessible from the main app layout after login.
acceptanceCriteria: The ⓘ Build Info panel is visible and accessible after login
The panel correctly shows Backend Actor status and Authentication status
Build Time and Commit Hash fields are displayed in the panel

requirements.text: Preserve all 7 sidebar navigation modules exactly as they exist: Dashboard, Inventory, Challans, Payments, Petty Cash, Client Balances, and Reports. RENTIQ branding must appear in the sidebar. No changes to module structure or functionality.

quotes: All 7 modules: Dashboard, Inventory, Challans, Payments, Petty Cash, Client Balances, Reports

acceptanceCriteria: Sidebar shows all 7 modules: Dashboard, Inventory, Challans, Payments, Petty Cash, Client Balances, Reports
RENTIQ branding (logo/app name) is visible in the sidebar
All module pages load and function correctly after authentication

constraints: Do not modify any immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, or components/ui
Do not change the Motoko backend schema or actor logic — this is a frontend-only fix
Preserve all existing module functionality (Inventory, Challans, Payments, Petty Cash, Client Balances, Reports, Dashboard)
Do not remove or restructure the BuildInfo component or its ⓘ trigger button
nonGoals: Adding new modules or features beyond restoring the working state
Changing the visual design or color theme
Changing the authentication provider from Internet Identity
